Maya C: Morning challenge—mini plant rap battle. Two-line rap for your desk plant. Winner gets a 'mystery sticker'. GO! :seedling: :microphone:
Drew: ok hold my coffee:
Drew: "My succulent's chill, no need to water, photosynthesizing like a street-smart otter." :sunglasses:
Samir: lol that's harsh but good. here's mine:
Samir: "Fern in the corner, flexing fronds of fame, low-key photosynth, but stealing your name." :seedling:
Jen: two-line haiku rap? love it. vote with reactions. :raised_hands:
Kai: Plant flex: "Cactus never whines, pricks when offended, sunbathing pro, always recommended." :cactus:
Maya C: OK Samir and Drew are neck-and-neck. who wants the sticker? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
OpsBot: Reminder: sticker supply is in the kitchen drawer labeled 'swag'. Low stock: 12.
Jen: also quick kudos—Samir saved the build yesterday, legend. :1st_place_medal:
Drew: thanks! but shoutout to Kai for fixing the plant lamp plug. :tada:
Samir: teamwork + plants = productivity. tiny poll: should we start a monthly 'plant rap' slack thread? :seedling: :one: yes :two: no
Kai: yes from me. would love more tiny chaos. :laughing:
Maya C: Alright I'm closing this with a consolation prize: everyone who posted gets a digital sticker in #sticker-bucket. :gift:
Jen: cutest tiny contest ever. good morning all. :coffee:
Maya C: thread locked (jk). keep 'em coming tomorrow. :microphone:
